mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand growth) signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite GDPC1 growth in 3 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in UNRATE above 9.8% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as it signals labor market tightening anticipation.
failure_condition: 5d returns not positive despite UNRATE crossing threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) create a balanced market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite both proxies rising in the same quarter.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), elevated FEDFUNDS rates compress equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not negative despite FEDFUNDS rising in the tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (supply growth) reflects robust production capacity, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite INDPRO growth in 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden jump in GDPC1 above 13,000 billions of chained 2017 dollars triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as it signals robust demand growth.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite GDPC1 crossing threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high labor participation (PAYEMS) and low FEDFUNDS rates create a favorable environment for equity markets, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite both proxies at favorable levels.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in CPIAUCSL below 215 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as it signals potential rate cuts.
failure_condition: 5d returns not positive despite CPIAUCSL falling below 215 in late-cycle.
